items.title: 52240_Frank _Machito_ Grillo oral history interview
items.q: everytime Varona didn't show up, Jose Curbelo took his place... he say: 'Jose Curbelo.'

ctx.x: Okay. Ah - you and Mario never made it to Panama. What did you do after that in 1926?
1926? Well, Mario was working with Jose Curbelo's father at the Summer Casino for two years and then he worked at The Montmatre.
And what - and then what were you doing about that time?

items.title: 52240_Frank _Machito_ Grillo oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Mario told me that the last band he worked with and he was discriminated against, was -ah- Curbelo's father, Jose Curbelo's father. [INTERVIEWEE] Yeah.

ctx.x: Well, we were together always. The last year that he played in Cuba was at the Montmartre, with Gilberto Valdes. He made a combination because that was all-white band, but Gilberto Valdes was very liberal. Being white, he was very liberal and he hired Mario.
Mario told me that the last band he worked with and he was discriminated against, was -ah- Curbelo's father, Jose Curbelo's father.
